verdict.rationale: Sentry's source is publicly readable: it has a GitHub repo, users describe reading the code to build integrations, and self-hosting starts with a git clone. However, the community evidence says the code was relicensed to the Business Source License, which at least one user treats as no longer open, so the 'open license' part of the story is undercut. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the current license terms, evidence the license qualifies as an open (OSI-style) license, and first-party docs on how to access and read the source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Sentry is the debugging platform that helps every developer detect, trace, and fix issues.
